local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local Base  = require(script.Parent.Base)
local C = Theme.Color

return function(o) -- {Eyebrow, Title, Size, Parent} -> {Instance, Body}
	local card = Base.new("Frame", {                      -- Frame, not TextButton
		Size = o.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(360, 300), BorderSizePixel = 0,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
	})
	Base.corner(card, Theme.Radius.Card); Base.fill(card, C.S1, C.S1b)
	Base.stroke(card, C.Line, 1, Theme.LineT); Base.shadow(card, 0.6, 46); Base.pad(card, 16)

	Base.new("TextLabel", { Text = string.upper(o.Eyebrow or ""), Font = Theme.Font, TextSize = 11,
		TextColor3 = C.Off, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left }, card)
	Base.new("TextLabel", { Text = o.Title or "", Font = Theme.Font, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = C.Ink,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left }, card)

	local body = Base.new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 46),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -46) }, card)

	if o.Parent then card.Parent = o.Parent end          -- <-- was missing
	return { Instance = card, Body = body }
end
